LoRA · Low-Rank Adapter Playground.zh: LoRA · 低秩适配器实验场

Full fine-tuning of a 70B model touches.zh: 对 70B 模型做全量微调需要更新 700 亿个参数。LoRA 则仅更新 2 亿个。二者质量往往难以区分，而 checkpoint 体积小 300 倍。拖动秩的滑块，观察各数值的变化；随后观看一个实时 SVD 如何随 $r$ 增大而复原目标矩阵。
Full fine-tuning of a 70B model touches.src: Full fine-tuning of a 70B model touches 70 billion parameters. LoRA touches 200 million. Quality is often indistinguishable, and the checkpoint is 300× smaller. Slide the rank and see the numbers move; then watch a live SVD recover a target matrix as $r$ grows.

@@T0@@The @@T1@@change@@T2@@ you want to.src: The change you want to apply to a pretrained weight is typically low-rank (Hu et al., 2021). You don't need 70B parameters of update budget — you need a tiny correction. So instead of fine-tuning $W \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$, parameterise the update as

where $B \\in \\mathbb{R}^{d \\times r}$.zh: 其中 $B \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times r}$、$A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d}$，且 $r \ll d$。基座 $W_0$ 保持冻结；只有 $A$ 与 $B$ 获得梯度。标量 $\alpha/r$ 使有效步长在不同秩之间保持稳定。在初始化时 $B = 0$，因此 LoRA 项恒为零，模型恰为预训练模型 —— 这是一个有保证的起点。
where $B \\in \\mathbb{R}^{d \\times r}$.src: where $B \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times r}$ and $A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d}$ with $r \ll d$. The base $W_0$ stays frozen; only $A$ and $B$ get gradients. The scalar $\alpha/r$ keeps the effective step size stable across ranks. At initialisation $B = 0$, so the LoRA term is identically zero and the model is exactly the pretrained one — a guaranteed starting point.

Why \"low-rank update\" is the right pri.zh: 为何「低秩更新」是恰当的先验
Why \"low-rank update\" is the right pri.src: Why "low-rank update" is the right prior

The Hu&nbsp;et&nbsp;al. paper measured t.zh: Hu 等的论文测量了在下游任务上微调预训练 transformer 的内在维度，发现它极小 —— 当 $d = 4096$ 时往往低于 $r = 8$。对此有两种理解方式：
The Hu&nbsp;et&nbsp;al. paper measured t.src: The Hu et al. paper measured the intrinsic dimensionality of fine-tuning a pretrained transformer on downstream tasks and found it was tiny — often under $r = 8$ for $d = 4096$. Two ways to think about this:

@@T0@@Empirical.@@T1@@ Fine-tuning datas.zh: @@T0@@实证角度。@@T1@@ 与预训练（万亿词元）相比，微调数据集很小（数千个样本）。微调数据中的信号不足以让权重沿数千个独立方向移动；只有少数几个方向占主导。
@@T0@@Empirical.@@T1@@ Fine-tuning datas.src: Empirical. Fine-tuning datasets are small (thousands of examples) compared to pretraining (trillions of tokens). There's just not enough signal in the fine-tuning data to move the weights along thousands of independent directions; only a few dominate.

@@T0@@Geometric.@@T1@@ Pretrained featur.zh: @@T0@@几何角度。@@T1@@ 预训练特征已经张成了大部分有用的子空间。微调只是将该子空间轻微旋转，而这恰恰就是一个低秩扰动。
@@T0@@Geometric.@@T1@@ Pretrained featur.src: Geometric. Pretrained features already span most of the useful subspace. Fine-tuning rotates that subspace by a small amount, which is exactly a low-rank perturbation.

Live: how rank $r$ approximates the true.src: Live: how rank $r$ approximates the true update

At $r = 8$ for a 7B model, you have ~4M.zh: 对于 7B 模型，在 $r = 8$ 时你有约 400 万个可训练参数。你可以在单张 24 GB 消费级 GPU 上完成微调，将适配器保存为约 16 MB 的文件，并与基座权重一同分发。基座从不改变 —— 你可以在其上叠加许多适配器。
At $r = 8$ for a 7B model, you have ~4M.src: At $r = 8$ for a 7B model, you have ~4M trainable parameters. You can fine-tune on a single 24 GB consumer GPU, save the adapter as a ~16 MB file, and ship it next to the base weights. The base never changes — you can layer many adapters on top.

Hyperparameter choices and how to set th.zh: 超参数的选择与设定方法
Hyperparameter choices and how to set th.src: Hyperparameter choices and how to set them

For most LLM tasks $r \\in \\{4, 8, 16\\.zh: 对大多数 LLM 任务而言 $r \in \{4, 8, 16\}$ 已足够。除非你的任务对模型作出显著适配 —— 例如注入一种全新的模态 —— 否则更大的 $r$ 并无助益。若怀疑需要更高的秩，可按对数尺度扫描 $r$。
For most LLM tasks $r \\in \\{4, 8, 16\\.src: For most LLM tasks $r \in \{4, 8, 16\}$ is enough. Larger $r$ doesn't help unless your task adapts the model significantly — e.g. injecting a brand-new modality. Sweep $r$ logarithmically if you suspect higher rank is needed.

2. Scaling $\\alpha$ and the $\\alpha/r$.zh: 2. 缩放系数 $\alpha$ 与 $\alpha/r$ 约定

$\\alpha$ is a scalar applied to $BA$ at.zh: $\alpha$ 是推理时施加于 $BA$ 的标量。约定「$\alpha/r$」可在扫描 $r$ 时使 LoRA 项的有效学习率大致保持恒定 —— 便于超参数搜索。常见取法：$\alpha = 2r$，或不论 $r$ 如何均取 $\alpha = 16$。
$\\alpha$ is a scalar applied to $BA$ at.src: $\alpha$ is a scalar applied to $BA$ at inference. The "$\alpha/r$" convention keeps the effective learning rate of the LoRA term roughly constant as you sweep $r$ — handy for hyperparameter search. Typical: $\alpha = 2r$ or $\alpha = 16$ regardless of $r$.

The original paper recommends $W_q$ and.zh: 原始论文仅推荐 $W_q$ 与 $W_v$。较新的实证研究（Dettmers、Pagnoni 等，2023）为获得最佳质量，往往注入全部 $\{W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o\}$ 以及 MLP 的上、下投影。成本与注入模块数量成正比。
The original paper recommends $W_q$ and.src: The original paper recommends $W_q$ and $W_v$ only. Newer empirical surveys (Dettmers, Pagnoni et al., 2023) often inject into all of $\{W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o\}$ plus the MLP up-and-down projections for the best quality. Cost is linear in number of injected modules.

A small dropout (0.05–0.10) inside the L.zh: 在 LoRA 路径内部使用较小的 dropout（0.05–0.10），可在小规模微调集上稳定训练，且不影响基座。对于极小的适配器可略去。
A small dropout (0.05–0.10) inside the L.src: A small dropout (0.05–0.10) inside the LoRA path stabilises training on small fine-tuning sets without affecting the base. Skip it for tiny adapters.

The math, with the right details.src: The math, with the right details

At initialisation: $A \\sim \\mathcal{N}.zh: 在初始化时：$A \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$（Kaiming 式），$B = 0$。于是 $BA = 0$，模型输出恰为预训练模型。关键在于，这意味着在训练做出任何有益之事之前，LoRA 从不@@T0@@损害@@T1@@基座。
At initialisation: $A \\sim \\mathcal{N}.src: At initialisation: $A \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$ (Kaiming-style), $B = 0$. So $BA = 0$ and the model output is exactly the pretrained one. Crucially, this means LoRA never damages the base before training has done anything useful.

After training, you have a choice:.zh: 训练之后，你有两种选择：
After training, you have a choice:.src: After training, you have a choice:

@@T0@@Keep LoRA modules separate.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@将 LoRA 模块保持独立。@@T1@@ 每层推理前向传播的开销为 $O(d^2 + 2rd)$。这使你能在服务时切换或组合适配器。当你希望在一个基座上托管众多任务专用适配器时使用。
@@T0@@Keep LoRA modules separate.@@T1@@.src: Keep LoRA modules separate. Inference forward pass costs $O(d^2 + 2rd)$ per layer. Lets you swap or compose adapters at serve time. Use when you want to host many task-specific adapters on one base.

@@T0@@Merge into base.@@T1@@ Set $W \\le.zh: @@T0@@合并进基座。@@T1@@ 令 $W \leftarrow W_0 + \frac{\alpha}{r} BA$。推理与基座完全相同 —— 零开销。当该适配器即为最终版本时使用。
@@T0@@Merge into base.@@T1@@ Set $W \\le.src: Merge into base. Set $W \leftarrow W_0 + \frac{\alpha}{r} BA$. Inference is identical to the base — zero overhead. Use when this adapter is the final one.

QLoRA — fine-tune 70B on a single 48 GB.zh: QLoRA —— 在单张 48 GB GPU 上微调 70B
QLoRA — fine-tune 70B on a single 48 GB.src: QLoRA — fine-tune 70B on a single 48 GB GPU

QLoRA (Dettmers et&nbsp;al., 2023) is \".zh: QLoRA（Dettmers 等，2023）即「在 4 位基座上做 LoRA」。包含三个部分：
QLoRA (Dettmers et&nbsp;al., 2023) is \".src: QLoRA (Dettmers et al., 2023) is "LoRA on a 4-bit base." Three pieces:

@@T0@@NF4 quantisation.@@T1@@ 4-bit norm.zh: @@T0@@NF4 量化。@@T1@@ 4 位正态浮点 —— 其设计使量化分桶与预训练权重的分布相匹配。体积约为 fp16 的 1/4。
@@T0@@NF4 quantisation.@@T1@@ 4-bit norm.src: NF4 quantisation. 4-bit normal-float — designed so the quantisation buckets match the distribution of pretrained weights. ~4× smaller than fp16.

@@T0@@Double quantisation.@@T1@@ Quantis.zh: @@T0@@二次量化。@@T1@@ 对量化常数本身再作量化；可再节省若干比特。
@@T0@@Double quantisation.@@T1@@ Quantis.src: Double quantisation. Quantise the quantisation constants themselves; saves a few more bits.

@@T0@@Paged optimisers.@@T1@@ Use unifie.zh: @@T0@@分页优化器。@@T1@@ 使用统一内存，使优化器状态在梯度累积的高峰期溢出到 CPU。
@@T0@@Paged optimisers.@@T1@@ Use unifie.src: Paged optimisers. Use unified memory so optimiser state spills to CPU during gradient accumulation peaks.

The base sits frozen in 4-bit, dequantis.zh: 基座以 4 位冻结存放，在做矩阵乘法时即时反量化；LoRA 路径则保持 fp16/bf16。最终结果：以一小部分显存获得与 fp16 LoRA 相同的精度。
The base sits frozen in 4-bit, dequantis.src: The base sits frozen in 4-bit, dequantised on the fly for matmul; the LoRA path stays in fp16/bf16. End result: same accuracy as fp16 LoRA at a fraction of the memory.

from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_mo.src:
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model

lora_cfg = LoraConfig(
    r=8,                           # rank
    lora_alpha=16,                 # scale
    target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"],  # where to inject
    lora_dropout=0.05,
    bias="none",
)
model = get_peft_model(base_model, lora_cfg)
model.print_trainable_parameters()
# > trainable params: 4.2M   all params: 7B   trainable%: 0.06%

@@T0@@Catastrophic forgetting.@@T1@@ LoR.zh: @@T0@@灾难性遗忘。@@T1@@ 由于基座保持冻结，LoRA 的遗忘少于全量微调，但在域外生成上仍会漂移。应使用较小的学习率（典型为 1e-4）、早停，以及一个留出的域外评估集。
@@T0@@Catastrophic forgetting.@@T1@@ LoR.src: Catastrophic forgetting. LoRA forgets less than full FT because the base stays frozen, but it still drifts on out-of-domain generation. Use small learning rate (1e-4 typical), early stopping, and a held-out OOD eval set.

@@T0@@Mixing adapters.@@T1@@ Adapter-mix.zh: @@T0@@混合适配器。@@T1@@ 适配器专家混合（LoRAHub、Composing-LoRAs）使你能在推理时线性组合各任务适配器。对密切相关的任务有效；对相互正交的任务则迅速退化。
@@T0@@Mixing adapters.@@T1@@ Adapter-mix.src: Mixing adapters. Adapter-mix-of-experts (LoRAHub, Composing-LoRAs) lets you linearly combine task adapters at inference. Works for closely related tasks; degrades fast for orthogonal ones.

@@T0@@Don't use LoRA for pretraining-fro.zh: @@T0@@不要用 LoRA 做从零预训练。@@T1@@ 低秩先验仅当存在一个强大的预训练初始化可供扰动时才成立。预训练请使用全秩。
@@T0@@Don't use LoRA for pretraining-fro.src: Don't use LoRA for pretraining-from-scratch. The low-rank prior is only valid when there's a strong pretrained init to perturb. Pretrain in full rank.

@@T0@@Merging multiple adapters.@@T1@@ $.zh: @@T0@@合并多个适配器。@@T1@@ $W_0 + \sum_i \frac{\alpha_i}{r_i} B_i A_i$ —— 但它们可能相互干扰。在堆叠许多适配器时，使用 TIES 合并或 DARE 可获得更干净的结果。
@@T0@@Merging multiple adapters.@@T1@@ $.src: Merging multiple adapters. $W_0 + \sum_i \frac{\alpha_i}{r_i} B_i A_i$ — but they can interfere. Use TIES-merging or DARE for cleaner results when stacking many adapters.

@@T0@@Quantised vs fp16 inference.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@量化推理与 fp16 推理。@@T1@@ 若你使用 QLoRA 训练，仍可以 fp16 部署合并后的模型 —— 只需在合并前将基座反量化一次。
@@T0@@Quantised vs fp16 inference.@@T1@@.src: Quantised vs fp16 inference. If you trained with QLoRA, you can still serve the merged model at fp16 — just dequantise the base once before merging.

LoRA is the rare technique where the \"l.zh: LoRA 是一种罕见的技术：「偷懒」的做法竟然能与严谨的做法相匹敌。对于参数规模 > 10 亿的预训练模型上 99% 的微调任务，都从 LoRA $r=8$、$\alpha = 16$、注入 $\{W_q, W_v\}$ 开始。若无法承担 fp16 基座的成本，则转向 QLoRA。只有在测到真实差距之后，才考虑 DoRA / AdaLoRA。
LoRA is the rare technique where the \"l.src: LoRA is the rare technique where the "lazy" version actually matches the careful one. For 99% of fine-tuning tasks on pretrained models > 1B params, start with LoRA $r=8$, $\alpha = 16$, $\{W_q, W_v\}$ injection. Move to QLoRA if you can't afford fp16 base. Reach for DoRA / AdaLoRA only after you've measured a real gap.

meta.title: LoRA · 低秩适配器实验场
meta.tagline: 拖动秩，观察可训练参数如何缩减 500 倍
meta.summary: LoRA 在一个冻结的基座权重旁注入两个小矩阵 A 与 B。按构造 B·A 即为低秩 —— 于是微调 70B 模型就变成微调每层两个 32k 参数的矩阵。拖动秩，用真实数字观察容量与成本之间的权衡。
highlights: 将秩 r 从 1 拖到 64 —— 观察可训练参数从数千降到数百万再到数十亿。
切换模型规模（1B、7B、70B），观察存储空间的节省。
与全量微调、Adam 优化器状态以及 LoRA 的节省量进行对比。
使用 peft 库的一行 PyTorch 代码。
QLoRA 预览 —— 4 位量化基座有何不同。
